recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid white (#FFFFFF).
2. Add the title text "Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance" at the top of the slide, spanning the full width, in a large, bold, dark red (#8B0000), sans-serif typeface.
3. Place a small yellow circle in the top-right corner and add the number "21" inside it.
4. Top-left: Build a 3×3 confusion-matrix legend table (white fill #FFFFFF, black text #000000, dark red #C00000 header/accents). Top header row reads "Predicted as" across the two data columns; column headers are "P" and "N". Left column contains row labels "P" and "N" with the word "Actual" written vertically along the far-left edge. Data cells: row "P" contains "TP" and "FP"; row "N" contains "FN" and "TN".
5. Middle-left: Directly below the legend table, build an identical 3×3 confusion-matrix data table (white fill #FFFFFF, black text #000000, dark red #C00000 header/accents). Data cells: row "P" contains "5" and "0"; row "N" contains "4" and "2". Draw a red (#FF0000) circle around the cell containing "5".
6. Top-left, to the right of the legend table: Place an orange (#FFA500) rectangular highlight box with a dark red (#C00000) border and white (#FFFFFF) text reading "Threshold=0.1".
7. Center-right: Construct a left-to-right flowchart using the following shapes and connectors:
   a. White (#FFFFFF) rectangle labeled "Test Sample" with a small line-drawing airplane icon centered inside.
   b. Right-pointing arrow to a dark red (#8B0000) rectangle labeled "Model"; below the label add the subtitle "[Any value] - (0, +∞)"; place a purple circle containing a sigmoid curve icon inside the box.
   c. Right-pointing arrow to a blue (#0000FF) rectangle labeled "(0 --- 1)"; place the text "Predicted Value" above this box.
   d. Right-pointing arrow to a vertical dark red (#C00000) rectangle labeled "Threshold (e.g. 0.5)".
   e. Two branching arrows from the right edge of the threshold box: one to a light green (#90EE90) oval labeled "Class I", the other to a light purple (#DDA0DD) oval labeled "Class II".
8. Bottom half: Create a scatter-plot area.
   a. Draw a solid red (#C00000) horizontal line as the x-axis along the bottom.
   b. Add three tick marks on the x-axis and label them "0.0", "0.5", and "1.0" in black (#000000) text below the axis.
   c. Draw a vertical dashed blue (#0000FF) line near the x=0.1 position, extending from the top to the bottom of the plot area.
   d. Scatter line-drawing airplane icons throughout the plot area (source estimate: 12–15 icons; exact count unverified). Some icons may include small blue or red dots.
9. Cross-check every text string against the verbatim label list to ensure exact matches.
